data.body: debug-everything 2026-05-08: Out of scope for /dso:fix-bug — this is a retroactive multi-PR review remediation task, not a single code defect. Each PR since #49 requires a separate /dso:review invocation. Recommend creating an epic to track the retroactive review with one story per PR. Also: jira-dig-1650 has identical title (likely Jira-mirror duplicate) — needs human consolidation per CLAUDE.md rule 14 (cannot autonomously close).
